**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section (h) (p0072) is the assignment clause and it satisfies the preferred position on the material terms:

- **Our assignment rights:** we may assign without approval or consent to any affiliate, to a purchaser of all or substantially all assets related to the subject matter, or to any successor by merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction — the full M&A/affiliate carve-out.
- **Vendor assignment:** requires our prior written consent, subject only to a reasonableness standard.
- **Change of control:** the Agreement contains no change-of-control provision at all; the only termination triggers are insolvency-type events. The Vendor therefore has no exit or re-pricing right on our change of control.

Noted but not flagged (minor sub-elements): there is no express prohibition on the Vendor assigning to one of our competitors, and the affiliate/successor carve-out runs mutually rather than one-way in our favour. Neither is material, and mutual successor assignment is expressly acceptable under the fallback.
